# validate/decode_omitted_ok — a producer with no decode chain is valid; an
# omitted decode defaults to json at runtime. No diagnostics, exit 0.

exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
! stdout .

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

state:
  url:
    type: url
    default: "http://localhost:9999"

auth:
  none: {}

requests:
  - method: GET
    url: {ref: state.url}
    events_at: response.body.events

pagination:
  none: {}

error:
  mode: standard
